_about: music_convert.py / music_pack.py config. MADE-UP values, to show the shape: find your own tunes with music_extract.py --music-time, your bass sections with music_convert.py --report-bass, and your cuts from where your sequence loads. Keys starting _ are ignored.
_bass_sections: [row, channel 0-2 = A-C, or null for the kit's rule]: from that row on

pack._cuts: tune -> rows (from the tune's start) to cut a chunk at; then any chunk over bank bytes is cut to fit
